text:
64세 여성 환자, acute exacerbation of chronic kidney disease로 입원함.

BP 88/56 mmHg, HR 112 bpm, RR 22 breaths/min, BT 36.8°C 확인됨.

SpO2 94% on 2L O2 via nasal cannula 유지함.

Moderate weakness 호소함.

Labetalol 10 mg IV q8h 투여 중.

Nasal cannula 적용함.

Fluid resuscitation 시행함.

Foley 유지함.

Positive fluid balance 확인됨.

Clinical status: drowsy.

Renal team notify함 for dialysis evaluation.
